breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the integral method with the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ * g * A * (L - x) and δ = ∫₀ᴸ [P(x) / (A * E)] dx. It does not mention replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load, thereby eliminating the incorrect 'exact' approximation present in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth approach.
